details.description: Amazon Nova Canvas is Amazon's image generation and editing model, launched December 3, 2024 and accessed through Amazon Bedrock. It creates studio-quality images from text prompts up to 2048x2048 (4.19 million pixels) and supports image-conditioned generation, inpainting, outpainting, background removal, color-guided generation from a supplied palette, and subject-consistency fine-tuning. Every generated image carries an invisible watermark that a public Content Credentials tool can verify. AWS's Bedrock model card lists this v1 snapshot as in its Legacy lifecycle stage, with an end-of-life date of September 30, 2026.
advantages: Supports inpainting, outpainting, background removal and image-conditioned generation in addition to text-to-image generation (AWS Nova user guide).
Accepts 1 to 10 hex color codes to guide the color palette of generated images (AWS Nova user guide).
Adds an invisible watermark to every generated image, verifiable with a public Content Credentials tool, to help identify AI-generated content (AWS Nova user guide).
Supports fine-tuning for subject consistency, preserving a chosen subject such as a product or pet across generated images (AWS Nova user guide).
disadvantages: AWS's Bedrock model card lists this Nova Canvas v1 snapshot as in its Legacy lifecycle stage, with a Model EOL date of September 30, 2026, matching the catalog's deprecation date.
English only for prompts (AWS Nova user guide).
use_cases: Text-to-image generation for marketing, retail and entertainment visuals
Image editing via inpainting, outpainting and background removal
Color-guided product image generation and image variation from reference images
Subject-consistent image generation for a recurring product, pet or brand asset

notes: AWS's Bedrock model card for amazon.nova-canvas-v1:0 shows 'Model lifecycle: Legacy' with 'Model EOL date: September 30, 2026', exactly matching the catalog's deprecation_date -- confirms the catalog fact. AWS documents a max prompt length of 1024 characters (a character count, not a token count), which does not directly compare to the catalog's max_input_tokens of 2600; kept the catalog's value as authoritative and did not restate a different number. Found no accuracy-style benchmark scores from Amazon or a named leaderboard for this model.
